description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different sentiment analysis tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—when applied to two categories of tweets: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet”. The horizontal axis represents the tweet categories, labeled “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet”, and is categorical with no defined order. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Three bars are present for each category, representing the accuracy of each tool; TEXTBLOB bars are white with black hatching, VADER bars are light green, and ChatGPT bars are dark green. For “Emoji Tweets”, the TEXTBLOB bar has an approximate height of 0.3, the VADER bar reaches approximately 0.45, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 0.72. For “Overall Tweet”, the TEXTBLOB bar has an approximate height of 0.45, the VADER bar reaches approximately 0.63, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 0.68. The bars are grouped by category, with each tool’s accuracy represented side-by-side within each category. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
